dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000pxef](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000pxef) Magnitude 5.4 earthquake at 73.061 depth occurred on Mar 07 2025 52km SW of Lapeng. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 5.4554 longitude 94.7104. It impacted 6586 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
